errors.text: The required moment tensor potential (MTP) and free-energy perturbation (FEP) intervention is replaced by an unspecified generic MLP and ambiguous proposals such as single-reference thermodynamic integration or frozen-phonon perturbation.
The hypothesis changes the target TaVCrW alloy to unrelated example compositions and does not reproduce the relevant 0 GPa, 2000–2400 K, GGA-PBE/LDA, or large-supercell conditions.
The claimed systematic EAM overestimation of melting temperature is unsupported by the cited evidence.
Evidence about descriptor-based regression of elastic moduli is conflated with evidence for an interatomic potential accurately reproducing liquid-phase DFT energy distributions.
